action: @Hina transfers @Star gently into @Mimi’s two paws from below. @Mimi draws one headphone cushion close to the star by tilting its head, keeping the headphones worn; no hand removes them. @Mochi watches quietly.
camera: Medium close 65mm, fixed; paws, star and headphone cushion visible.
audio: Soft felt transfer. Instrumental score drops to near silence to reveal the clue.
end_state: @Mimi holds the star close to its left headphone cushion.

action: @Star plays a tiny three-note C5–E5–G5 bell pattern, separated and gentle. @Mimi pauses to listen, ears perking through a small head tilt. Then @Mimi hums the SAME three-note contour very softly, with closed-mouth wordless mmm sounds only.
camera: Hard cut to close 85mm on @Mimi’s face, headphone and supported star. No visible words or sung syllables.
audio: Star bell C5–E5–G5, then a soft matching wordless hum. No spoken language.
end_state: The cat has discovered a musical response.

action: As @Mimi hums, @Star brightens and floats a finger-width ABOVE its open paws, clearly separating by only two centimeters. @Mochi leans in with delighted recognition. @Mimi then lowers its open paws toward a flat moss patch and lets @Star settle there. Hold on its faint glow.
camera: Hard cut to medium 65mm with the moss patch in view; tiny camera tilt follows the controlled placement.
audio: One warm reply chime and a quiet delighted breath, no words.
end_state: @Star rests on flat moss near the lower slope; @Mimi is beside it.
